import (
	stdout from "@std/io/io.ms",
	HttpRequest,
	HttpResponse,
	HttpServerOptions,
	buffered,
	headers from "@std/net/http.ms",
	serve from "@std/net/net.ms",
)

fn handle(request: HttpRequest) HttpResponse:
	return HttpResponse(200, headers(), "hello {request.path}".to_bytes())

export fn main() Int:
	options := HttpServerOptions(
		max_requests: 2,
		max_body_bytes: 1024,
		max_response_bytes: 1024,
		timeout: 2.seconds(),
		grace: 0.seconds(),
	)

	if acquired := serve(
		address: "127.0.0.1:0",
		handler: buffered(handle),
		options: options,
	):
		server := acquired
		if stdout().write("{server.address()}\n").is_error(): return 1

		_ignored := server.wait()
		return 0

	return 1
